concerns.text: T103 claims deviation_contexts.csv 'conforming to interaction_context.schema.yaml field names' but specifies columns 'smiles,bit_index,matched_substructure,interaction_strength'. The contract requires bit_i, bit_j, interaction_strength, substructure_desc, context_type. The task's deliverable falls short of the contract it cites — either emit the schema's fields or amend the contract; as written the verification will pass a non-conforming artifact.

Plan task T028 (per-molecule JSON records conforming to prediction.schema.yaml under data/derived/predictions/) is silently dropped: no task covers it and T106's artifact inventory omits it. Dropping a plan deliverable without documented justification is a dropped acceptance criterion.

Plan promises data/derived/validation_audit.pdf (T057); T106's inventory checks 'validation_audit.md'. The tasks doc says the audit content is 'already verified and preserved' but the plan's promised PDF deliverable is not verified by any task — the format/filename drift means the plan's deliverable is silently relaxed.

FR-007 requires mapping SHAP bits to substructures without qualification; T103 (and plan T029) restricts to MACCS and labels ECFP4/FP2 bits 'uninterpretable'. The narrowing is reasonable but is a retroactive narrowing of the FR not reflected in the spec — document the MACCS-only scope in spec.md FR-007 so the task is not silently weakening the requirement.

T103's unit test asserts 'no empty matched_substructure cells' while the task itself mandates labeling unmatched bits 'unmapped' and hashed bits 'uninterpretable' — the verification criterion is internally inconsistent with the deliverable spec; clarify that labeled cells count as non-empty or tighten the assertion.
